name: Galvaani Bash
original_name: ガルヴァーニ・バッシ
source:
One of the teachers at Voromia Academy.

Is an elf and his main vocation is researcher, although he's quiet poor with always trying to sell stuff to his students. Homeroom teacher of Abels class. Also good friend of Jozue
